# Austins Department Store

> A heritage family-owned UK department store in Newton Abbot offering fashion, toys, homeware, beauty, and gifting solutions with premium brands like Christy, Molton Brown, and more.

Austins Department Store is a long-established retail destination in Devon featuring curated product categories across fashion, toys, homeware, and beauty. The store combines traditional department store values with modern e-commerce, offering everything from luxury Egyptian cotton towels to children's toys and gift solutions.
